title: 美债一周过山车 交易员暂歇观望
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: I think it is the most important because it's very much at the center of the discussion around what's going on in the Treasury market this week.
segments.zh: 我认为这非常重要，因为它正是本周国债市场讨论的核心。

segments.en: And when you think about the underlying fundamentals of the economy, you know, six and a half percent year-over-year growth in nominal GDP is, you know, I think a very, sort of very indicative
segments.zh: 考虑到经济基本面，名义GDP同比增长6.5%，这很能说明问题。

segments.en: of course of what we're seeing in terms of the AI boom, but I think also in the context of inflation as well, you know, you can't really get inflation down to two percent unless
segments.zh: 这当然反映了AI热潮，但也与通胀相关。除非出现前所未有的生产力繁荣，否则通胀很难降到2%。

segments.en: you see sort of the greatest productivity boom ever. So it's not a bad thing.
I don't mean that in a bad way, but I think that to the content, you know, to the point of this sort of booming economy and the resilience that we see in the US, we have sort of entered
segments.zh: 我并非贬义，但就经济繁荣和美国韧性而言，我们已进入新常态。

segments.en: this new normal where it's now more normal to see nominal growth of that kind versus what we saw pre-pandemic, which was much slower than six and a half percent.
segments.zh: 如今这种名义增长比疫情前更常见，那时增速远低于6.5%。

segments.en: I want to talk about the bond market because Tom and I earlier in the show, we said that is the big story of this week.
segments.zh: 我想谈谈债券市场，因为我和汤姆早些时候说过，这是本周的大新闻。

segments.en: What did the market learn from the bond moves and the best input, so to speak?
segments.zh: 市场从债券走势中学到了什么？

segments.en: And it's rapid reversal. Is it that they're skeptical about this move?
segments.zh: 快速逆转是否意味着市场对此持怀疑态度？

segments.en: I mean, many people have called it the bad aid, just a bad aid, really, but...
segments.zh: 很多人称之为“坏援助”，但……

segments.en: No, I mean, I think that's probably the right way to think about it, you know, the sort of duct tape on a leaky pipe situation where that can only last for so long and in terms
segments.zh: 我认为这可能是正确的思考方式，就像用胶带修补漏水管道，只能维持一段时间，

segments.en: of stemming some of the, you know, some of the drippage there. But I think that the whole discussion around, you know, higher deficits and the fact that,
segments.zh: 以减缓一些渗漏。但围绕更高赤字以及两党都未采取行动的讨论，

segments.en: you know, no one's really doing anything about it on either side of the aisle, that's been the theme, you know, in a feature of the U.S. for so long, but that in combination with
